title: Burning Rate Emulator
summary: Gaseous burner tests emulating the burning of solid and liquid fuels, using methane and ethylene at oxygen levels from 21% to 40%.

title: Electric Field Effects on Flames
summary: Applies a high-voltage electric field to microgravity flames. The ion wind mimics some effects of gravity, but this is NOT partial-gravity data and must never be presented as such.
embedded_notes: Fuel Conc. (diluted with nitrogen on a volume basis) was varied between tests, but typically matched the bottle. The list only accounts for flames ignited.

title: Burning and Suppression of Solids II
summary: 129 solid-fuel tests aboard the ISS covering PMMA rods, films, slabs and spheres, SIBAL fabric, Nomex and candles, at oxygen levels from 13.6% to 22.2% in low-velocity forced flow.

title: Burning and Suppression of Solids
summary: The first BASS campaign. 122 tests on PMMA spheres and slabs, SIBAL, Nomex, Ultem and wax candles. The experimental table records materials and dates only; conditions and outcomes live in the final report.

title: Cool Flames Investigation
summary: 87 droplet tests of dodecane and iso-dodecane blends across pressures from 0.5 to 5 atm at 17% and 21% oxygen.

title: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test
summary: Two sessions measuring Arizona Road Dust aerosol with P-Trak and DustTrak instruments, to understand how dust confuses spacecraft smoke detectors.

title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment 2
summary: A summary of the parameter ranges covered by FLEX-2 droplet tests. These 8 rows describe ranges, not individual tests.

title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
summary: 274 methanol and heptane droplet tests with labelled outcomes, using carbon dioxide and helium as suppressants. The discovery of invisible cool flames came from this campaign.

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment I
summary: The largest fire ever set in space: a 94 by 40.6 cm SIBAL fabric sample burned aboard an uncrewed Cygnus vehicle, comparing concurrent and opposed flow spread.

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment II
summary: Nine samples of silicone, SIBAL, PMMA and Nomex. The only PSI table that records both microgravity and normal-gravity behaviour for the same samples, which makes it the only honest source for a 0 g versus 1 g comparison.
embedded_notes: Note 1 Derived from measured CO2 production and referenced to initial O2 concentration reported by ISS.
Note 2 The PMMA portion was completely consumed but the Nomex was not ignited.
Note 3 This is the length of fuel with significant visible damage.
Note 4 The flames remain anchored at the base of the sample which has a very slow regression rate (0.01 to 0.04 mm/s)

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment III
summary: Two large-scale SIBAL fabric burns at 30 cm/s, one concurrent and one opposed.

title: Smoke Aging and Measurement Experiment (Reflight)
summary: 109 tests measuring how smoke particles grow as they age, across Kapton, silicone, lampwick, Teflon and Pyrell. Samples were heated without flaming, so this is pyrolysis smoke, not fire smoke.

title: Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment
summary: 469 gaseous-fuel tests measuring the point at which a flame begins to produce soot, using ethylene, propane, propylene blends and methane across three nozzle sizes.

title: Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
summary: 179 tests separating cool-flame behaviour from hot ignition in ethane, propane and butane mixtures, with seven identified cool-flame regimes labelled PCI-A through PCI-G.
